class: Planner choose action bypasses verified date entry
symptom: Self Identify date segments failed to commit and became corrupted while the application attempted to enter today's date.
root_cause: The fill action used verified composite-date handling, but choose used plain fill_and_dispatch even for spinbuttons. The planner selected choose on the live form.
fix: Route choose on spinbuttons through the same verified numeric/date handler as fill.
reproduction: The choose variant of the composite-date regression failed before the fix while fill passed.
